_instructions: Do not leak planning administration terms into product code names, variables, paths or features.

evidenceIndex.claim: WLT sole financial owner; official-wallet/manual settlement/reconciliation/blocking close are canonical.
All four actor apps plus control-panel require scoped canonical wallet/ledger readback through DSH/WLT.
Settlement/commission truth requires WLT calculation/evidence/policy/ledger and multi-surface readback.
Canonical double-entry and legacy wlt_ledger_entries compatibility stores coexist; legacy table is still written at ledger.go:111 and read at ledger.go:138/175/200.
Daily close totals legacy wlt_ledger_entries (line 73) and counts unverified manual payout evidence (line 105) without blocking, ending at the literal comment 'We proceed.' (line 116).
Destination defaults to 'bank' (line 43) and accepts bank/mobile_money (line 49) with 'manual' treated as a destination method (line 53).
Penalty posts ledger then directly locks and mutates wlt_wallets (line 140) rather than deriving the wallet projection from canonical postings.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Other direct writers require current-head sweep.

evidenceIndex.claim: Onboarding fee policy uses float64 amounts (lines 19/33) and a singleton row 'WHERE id = 1' (lines 63/127/158) without durable per-context audit.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Full route/data inventory deferred to U007.

evidenceIndex.claim: Checkout consumes canonical minor-unit snapshots, while promotion funding/pricing still require trusted-scope and canonical-accounting proof.
evidenceIndex.limitations: DSH/WLT source and accounting lineage must be traced end-to-end.

evidenceIndex.claim: Dispatch eligibility is a WLT financial decision based on wallet/policy and therefore in scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: DSH consumption/runtime freshness not yet proven.

evidenceIndex.claim: A governed wallet mutation DecisionService is wired and fail-closed on head, resolving the historical nil-DecisionService gate defect.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Landed by concurrent work on BB, not by this package; deny/unavailable runtime paths still require execution evidence.
